meta.source: Unify design tokens (April 30 kit, carried in the Impact Post file), the Unify brand skill, the contributor flyer and the 221 Students impact post. Where they conflict, the April tokens win.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background on every surface: product, notes, website and social posts. Warm off-white in light, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals and the subtopic card in notes. Sits on bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed surface inside a card: formula and definition panels, quick checks, recall answers, input fields.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only (1.2:1 on bg in light), so a control's outline uses border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of interactive controls (inputs, answer options, secondary buttons) at 3:1 or better on bg, surface and surface-2. Added by this kit; the April kit has no equivalent.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and all headings on bg, surface and surface-2. 17.9:1 on bg in light, 16.7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions and eyebrows on bg, surface and surface-2. 6.8:1 on bg in light, 8.3:1 in dark. April kit: text2.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders, disabled labels. April kit: text3. Only 2.6:1 on bg in light and 3.3:1 in dark, so never use it for anything a student has to read.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: THE brand accent. Fills, progress, active states, the social green bar, huge stat numbers, the full stop in the wordmark. Never as text below 120px on bg in light (1.6:1). Put on-green text on it.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: Green text at 24px and up, and bold 19px and up: headline words, links in large type, the green second line of a quote on a social post (3.3:1 on white, 3.0:1 on bg). For smaller green text use green-text.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Small green text on bg, surface and surface-2 (4.6:1 on bg, 5.0:1 on surface): chips, links, correct-answer feedback. Added by this kit because green-deep fails 4.5:1 at small sizes.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Background of green tags, the correct-answer option, the active nav item. Text on it: green-text or text. April kit: green-bg.

tokens.name: green-tint-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a green tag. Decorative, always paired with a word. April kit: green-border.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on green fills: the green CTA, green badges, check circles. 11.4:1 on green. Never white on green.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Streaks, confidence ratings and Past Questions, sparingly. Fill only; near-black on it (11.9:1).

tokens.name: amber-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an amber chip (Past Q, streak). Text on it: text. April kit: yellow-bg.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (delete, leave course), as an icon or fill with a word beside it. Not for wrong quiz answers. 3.4:1 on bg in light, so red text must be 24px or bold 19px; smaller red text uses red-text.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Small destructive labels on bg and surface (5.9:1 on bg in light, 5.1:1 in dark). Added by this kit.

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a destructive confirmation panel. April kit: red-bg.

tokens.name: invert-bg
tokens.usage: Dark hero banners on light pages: the dashboard greeting, the notes topic header, the website hero. Flips to light in dark mode so the banner still stands out.

tokens.name: invert-text
tokens.usage: Headings and body on invert-bg (18:1 in light, 17.2:1 in dark).

tokens.name: invert-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and eyebrows on invert-bg (7.0:1 in light, 6.9:1 in dark). Added by this kit because the April invert-sub value is too faint to read.

tokens.name: invert-accent
tokens.usage: Green text on invert-bg: the eyebrow in a dark banner and in the notes topic header. 11.4:1 in light. In dark mode the banner turns light, so this darkens to 6.2:1 on #f0efeb. Added by this kit.

tokens.name: invert-border
tokens.usage: Dividers inside an inverted banner or the dark checklist card on social posts.

tokens.name: tag-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral topic chip background. Text on it: text-muted, not the April tag-color #888 (3.1:1).

tokens.name: near-black
tokens.usage: Fixed near-black in both themes: the social footer strip, the dark checklist card on posts, reversed wordmark ground.

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: Fixed warm off-white in both themes: text on near-black, the ground of every social post.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Miss a class. Not the content.
styles.usage: Website hero and launch moments. Range 40 to 80px (April: clamp 40px, 8vw, 80px).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark at any size, full stop in green. 36px on a 1080px social post.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in the product and on the website. Range 28 to 48px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles in the product. Range 22 to 32px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles: course cards, stat cards.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Sub-card titles. The smallest size Playfair is ever set at.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: The knowledge was always in there.
styles.usage: Quotes, always Playfair italic. On a 1080px social post set at 46px with -1.5px tracking, the second line in green-deep.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: BUILT FOR THE ONES WHO BUILD.
styles.usage: The tagline, uppercase, in the same typeface as the wordmark. Directly under the wordmark, left-aligned to the U, about 30% of the wordmark's size (11px under a 36px wordmark).

styles.name: note-title
styles.usage: Topic title in the notes header, on invert-bg.

styles.name: note-heading
styles.usage: Subtopic heading at the top of each subtopic card.

styles.name: note-panel-title
styles.usage: Title of a formula or definition panel, a quick-check question, a recall question.

styles.name: note-body
styles.sample: The Laplace transform turns a differential equation into an algebraic one.
styles.usage: Every paragraph in a note. Never Playfair. Line length at most 68 characters.

styles.name: note-option
styles.sample: It converts differential equations into algebraic ones
styles.usage: Answer options and feedback lines in quick checks.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: 2 general courses and 4 departmental courses this semester.
styles.usage: Main text in the product and on the website (April: fs-body-lg).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mark it done when you actually understand it.
styles.usage: Default text, in text-muted (April: p, li at 1.7 line height).

styles.name: sm
styles.usage: Navigation, tabs, UI labels.

styles.name: xs
styles.usage: Small print and metadata.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tags, chips, meta labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase caps above titles. April sets it in green-deep, which is 3.0:1 at 10px; use text-muted on light grounds and invert-accent on invert-bg.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: All buttons.

styles.name: poster-stat
styles.usage: The one big number on an impact post, in green. Sizes for a 1080px canvas.

styles.name: poster-headline
styles.usage: Loud headline on social posts and flyers, near-black with one word or line in green-deep. Uppercase for calls to join, sentence case for results.

styles.name: poster-sub
styles.usage: Second line under a poster headline.

styles.name: poster-body
styles.sample: 330+ students have used Unify this month.
styles.usage: Supporting copy on a post, with a 20px text-muted line under it.

styles.name: poster-strip
styles.usage: Uppercase line in the near-black footer strip, in off-white.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tag vertical padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between answer options, inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tag horizontal padding, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter, gap between blocks inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, gap between cards in the product.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between subtopic cards in notes.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Social post inset from the left and top edges (on a 1080px canvas).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing on the website and in the product.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, tag backgrounds, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, answer options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, subtopic cards, panels, the composer box.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Course cards, accordions, the dark checklist card on social posts.

tokens.name: radius-poster
tokens.usage: Large rounded panels on flyers, as in the contributor flyer's instruction panel. Social only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, the active bottom-nav item, number chips.

shadow.note: Unify uses shadows sparingly: resting cards get a whisper, only hover and floating layers get more. Values from the April kit.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards: course cards, subtopic cards. Always with a border. Dark relies on the surface step instead.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: A course card or link card on hover. Product and website only, never in notes.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: Side drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the floating Box Boy moment.
